speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I understand you are experiencing fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise during your pregnancy; could you please tell me exactly how many weeks pregnant you are and when these symptoms started? Also, have you noticed any rash, stiff neck, or changes in your vision?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old female at 30 weeks gestation. The patient presents with a sudden onset of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. She reports the consumption of ice cream 3 days prior to the onset of symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Listeriosis (Maternal Listeria Monocytogenes infection).

The key detail here is the consumption of unpasteurized dairy (ice cream) three days before symptom onset in a third-trimester pregnant patient. This strongly suggests *Listeria monocytogenes*, which can cause flu-like symptoms in the mother and severe infection or death in the fetus/newborn. I am requesting blood cultures and a stool culture immediately to confirm the diagnosis.
